changeSet.author: FStavcev
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS orders ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY ,user_id BIGINT NOT NULL ,order_number VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL ,amount NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL ,status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'NEW' NOT NULL ,created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL ,CONSTRAINT uk_orders_order_number UNIQUE (order_number) ,CONSTRAINT ck_orders_status CHECK (status IN ('NEW', 'PAID', 'SHIPPED', 'CANCELLED')) ,CONSTRAINT fk_orders_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id) );

rollback.sql: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS orders CASCADE;
